body:
@vvo that is in the right direction. Not naming the define() is the right way to go, I believe it is necessary for webpack, and has caused people some grief: https://github.com/webpack/webpack/issues/989
They fixed this when using webpack with the command you mentioned.

I just need to figure out how to have my compiled js detect unnamed defines, and give them names at compile. I am not sure how to do this using requirejs. :(

In the future I will be migrating to webpack but for now I am using requirejs + almond.

I've yet to try building from the source.
